title: Clandestine Christian ex-special-forces group approaches the congressman

tellings.quote: they kind of bumped me is the best way to describe it in Washington DC with a at a different meeting.

plain: Congressman Eric Burlison says a secretive group of Christian former special forces soldiers approached him in Washington, DC, sometime between 2024 and 2026. He tells Michels firsthand that they "kind of bumped me" at a meeting about something else, which he says is "the best way to describe it". If true, it would mean a hidden group of former soldiers is quietly seeking out members of Congress.
